notes: Manifest v88 fixes the actual Android sidebar dimming root cause found by whole-file Chat analysis: chat.html places the root-level sidebar scrim before .app while base .app has z-index:1, creating a parent stacking context that traps the sidebar below the scrim regardless of the sidebar z-index. Android now dissolves the .app stacking context with z-index:auto so workspace < scrim(90) < sidebar(110). Runtime-only; no Vercel deploy or restart required.
